user.title: Secure Family
user.description: Add the Secure Family central configuration store. The family admin publishes settings from the app; everyone else just signs in.

abort.already_configured: Secure Family is already set up.

set_config.name: Set family configuration
set_config.description: Publish the central family configuration. Administrators only.

rollback.name: Roll back configuration
rollback.description: Restore a previous family configuration. Administrators only.

version.name: Version
version.description: The version number to restore. Omit to restore the latest previous version.

clear_config.name: Clear configuration
clear_config.description: Clear the central family configuration. Administrators only.

cleanup_stale_trackers.name: Clean up stale trackers
cleanup_stale_trackers.description: Remove old or duplicate Secure Family device registrations that stopped updating. Administrators only.

max_age_days.name: Max age (days)
max_age_days.description: Remove registrations not updated in at least this many days.

dry_run.name: Preview only
dry_run.description: List the registrations without deleting. Review first.

request_live_location.name: Request live location
request_live_location.description: Ask a family member's device to send its location at a fast rate briefly. Available to any family member.

entity_id.name: Person tracker
entity_id.description: The device_tracker of the family member.
